extDescription.message: Links from other apps stop over in a small, temporary window. Keep the page as a tab with one click, or close it.

actionTitle.message: Layover: open this tab in a mini window

cmdOpenInMain.message: Move the mini window's page into the main window as a tab

barAddTitle.message: Open this page as a tab in the main window

optSubtitle.message: Links from other apps (Mail, Slack, Messages…) stop over in a mini window first.

optEnabled.message: Open links from other apps in a mini window

optEffectsHint.message: The page fades in and out, buttons slide in, the window slides away when closed.

optSizeHint.message: Resizing a mini window by hand also updates this.

optPrivacy.message: Everything runs on your device. Layover doesn't collect, store or send your browsing data.

optLinkShortcut.message: Open a link in a mini window

hintPrimaryAlt.message: Free to use: in the browser it normally does the same as {primary} + click.

hintAltShift.message: Free to use: in the browser it normally does the same as {shift} + click.

hintShift.message: Replaces the browser's {shift} + click (open link in a new window).

hintOff.message: Right-click a link › Open in Layover still works.

hintAlso.message: Right-click › Open in Layover also works.

cmdPopTab.message: Open the current tab in a mini window

optSites.message: Never open in a mini window

optSitesHint.message: Links from other apps to these sites open as normal tabs. The shortcut and right-click still work.

optAutoCloseHint.message: A mini window you haven't looked at for this long closes by itself.

optShortcutTab.message: Move this tab into a mini window

optShortcutTabValue.message: Click the Layover icon in the toolbar

optCoffeeText.message: If it saves you time, a coffee keeps it going.
